reason: The command that all executive departments and independent establishments 'shall be closed on January 2, 2007' is limited to that one day by its own terms and was spent when that day ended. First end: 2007-01-02, inclusive; the actor is EO 13421 itself.

The exception for offices and installations that the agency heads determine should remain open qualifies the closing in section 1, which applies only to January 2, 2007. It has no object after that date. First end: 2007-01-02, inclusive; the actor is EO 13421 itself.

The command that executive branch departments and agencies close and excuse employees from duty on Monday, December 24, 2007 is limited by its own terms to that day, described as 'Monday, December 24, 2007, the day before Christmas Day', and was spent when that day ended. First end: 2007-12-24, inclusive; the actor is EO 13453 itself.

The authority of department and agency heads to keep offices open and employees on duty on December 24, 2007 qualifies the closing in section 1 and applies only to that date. First end: 2007-12-24, inclusive; the actor is EO 13453 itself.

The direction that Monday, December 24, 2007 be considered as falling within the scope of Executive Order 11582 and 5 U.S.C. 5546 and 6103(b) concerns that single day. First end: 2007-12-24, inclusive; the actor is EO 13453 itself.
